newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA BOOSTED AS BETIS ARE HELD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA BOOSTED AS BETIS ARE HELD.

text.p: Barcelona saw their hopes of taking Spain's second Champions' League place boosted on Sunday when they moved two points clear of third-placed Real Betis.

While Barcelona brushed aside Sporting Gijon 4-0, Betis conceded a late equaliser in the 2-2 home draw with Racing Santander. The result means that Barcelona move to within six points of Real Madrid who face Compostela on Monday.
Deportivo Coruna are a point behind Betis after squeezing a 1-0 win out of Zaragoza with a goal from Brazilian midfielder Rivaldo.
Barcelona never looked in trouble against Sporting and cruised to victory with goals from Ivan de la Pena, Juan Pizzi and Brazilians Giovanni and Ronaldo.
But they had Luis Enrique Martinez taken off on a stretcher and he is doubtful for Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup semifinal first leg against Fiorentina.
Barcelona's victory had looked likely to do no more than improve their goal difference advantage over Betis who had taken a 2-0 lead in their game.
But Racing struck back through Alfonso Perez and then Alberto Lopez made it 2-2 in the dying minutes, making up for his own goal that had put Betis ahead.
"We had a lot of chances and we let slip a game that we had under control...these things happen in football," lamented Alfonso. "We can't let these things occur, especially at home."
A further eight points back with a game in hand are champions Atletico Madrid who crashed 4-1 at Oviedo on Saturday.

Espanyol pulled out of the danger zone with a 1-0 win at fellow strugglers Rayo Vallecano, while Valencia crashed 4-1 at Valladolid, prompting speculation that coach Jorge Valdano may shortly face the sack.
The Houdini-like escape act of first division newcomers Extremadura continued with a 3-0 win over fellow strugglers Logrones.

Hercules beat Real Sociedad 2-1 to leave bottom place to Sevilla who drew 0-0 with Athletic Bilbao. The game was played in San Sebastian because of the closure of Bilbao's San Mames ground after a firework-throwing incident.
